scope: 40 selected public historical winning records: 20 HiLo and 20 Risky Click. Payout-model reconstruction only; not an RNG audit or a representative RTP sample.

methods.hilo: 13 equally likely ranks with replacement, inclusive higher/lower except strict opposite-direction calls at A/K; same is 1/13. Every successful paid call multiplies the reconstructed old value by 0.99/p. Skips change the current rank but apply no payout factor. Compare with 0.99/product(p) for a once-only factor.
methods.hilo_precision: Exact rational model; Decimal calculations at 70-digit precision. Recorded float values compared at 1e-12 relative tolerance. No per-row cent rounding in aggregate benchmark.
methods.risky: Enumerate all 511 non-empty subsets of the nine documented historical tile multipliers. Match the stored leaderboard multiplier within 0.0001. Each candidate once-only multiplier divides the old product by 0.99^(tiles-1). Choose the smallest once-only candidate for each row.
methods.risky_precision: Floor chosen once-only multiplier to four decimals; multiply the displayed USD stake, then floor gross USD to four decimals. A stored 40.1309 value is 0.0001 below exact product 40.131; this discrepancy is preserved.
methods.combined_precision: Sum unrounded HiLo route benchmarks and four-decimal floored Risky Click lower benchmarks, then subtract stored gross payouts. Round the final aggregate to cents with ROUND_HALF_UP.
methods.interpretation: YEET advertised a 1% house edge and 99% RTP. The benchmark charges that 1% once on the whole round, so the round returns 99% of the stake however many steps are taken. Charging it again at every step returns 0.99 to the power of the steps taken.
methods.limits: Public winning leaderboards are selected examples. Risky Click leaderboards do not disclose paths, so subset matches are compatible reconstructions, not revealed choices. Displayed USD stakes are the available unit for cross-record benchmarks; raw payouts may round differently from path multipliers. Source acquisition dates are locally recorded provenance, not independent timestamp attestations. No RNG generation is replayed.
